name: Fence

length.label: Length (m)
length.desc: Fence run length along local +X. Drag the dot on either end face to resize in the viewport; short runs are legitimate filler panels where a guard line meets a machine.

height.label: Height (m)
height.desc: Panel height. The base stays on the floor and the top face moves, so the viewport dot drags the top.

meshColor.label: Mesh color
meshColor.desc: Tint of the frame and the wire panel it holds.

omitPostStart.label: Omit start post
omitPostStart.desc: Suppress the post at local -X so a snapped neighbour draws the shared one instead. Snapping sets this for you.

omitPostEnd.label: Omit end post
omitPostEnd.desc: Suppress the post at local +X so a snapped neighbour draws the shared one instead. Snapping sets this for you.
